hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cargo clippy --quiet 2>&1 | head -30; fi
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cargo fmt --quiet; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '/\.claude/rules/'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"additionalContext": "Reminder: .github/instructions/ counterpart may need updating — run /copilot-sync"}}'; fi

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"additionalContext": "Hard rules: never write unencrypted sensitive data to disk. Never commit secrets. cargo fmt --all after Rust changes. Do not git add/commit — user handles it. master_key must not escape ceremony function body."}}'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'curl[[:space:]]+.+\|[[:space:]]*(ba)?sh|wget[[:space:]]+.+\|[[:space:]]*(ba)?sh'; then echo 'Blocked: pipe-to-shell pattern rejected'; exit 2; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(reset[[:space:]]+--hard|clean[[:space:]]+-[fdxFDX]+|checkout[[:space:]]+--|restore[[:space:]]+(\.|--source)|push[[:space:]]+--force|stash[[:space:]]+(drop|clear|pop))|rm[[:space:]]+-[a-z]*r[a-z]*f|rm[[:space:]]+-[a-z]*f[a-z]*r'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive operation requires explicit user approval'; exit 2; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(reset[[:space:]]+--hard|clean[[:space:]]+-[fdxFDX]+|checkout[[:space:]]+--|restore[[:space:]]+(\.|--source)|push[[:space:]]+--force|stash[[:space:]]+(drop|clear|pop))|Remove-Item[[:space:]].*-Recurse.*-Force|Remove-Item[[:space:]].*-Force.*-Recurse'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive operation requires explicit user approval'; exit 2; fi
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$path" | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.|/secrets/)'; then echo 'Blocked: sensitive file access rejected by hook'; exit 2; fi
